When I deposited 400k and after 3 days I withdraw 300k but I can't withdraw after deposit 7 days ...looks like a scam ....so don't deposit a higher amount so am suggesting friends don't deposit and fall into a real scammer

INDmoney bugs: Txn times show AEDT instead of IST. Indpay UPI scans ask for PIN then error out, requiring a force close. Critical Flaw: If an Indpay txn hangs due to low signal, the next payment pushes the old pending amount instead of the new one

themes.description: Users are facing severe difficulties in getting their issues resolved, with unresponsive support teams, automated bots, and looped AI agents that cannot resolve actual user problems. Many users are forced to write reviews due to frustration with not being able to get help.
themes.business_impact: Customer trust is severely eroded, and users are taking their business elsewhere, resulting in lost revenue and potential harm to INDmoney's reputation.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The lack of effective support mechanisms, outdated processes, and inadequate training for support staff are contributing factors to this issue.
themes.action_plan:
• Revamp existing support infrastructure to provide multiple, quick, and reliable channels for users to get their problems solved, and prioritize training support staff to effectively handle complex issues
• Introduce proactive outreach to identify and resolve potential issues proactively, rather than relying on users to escalate them
• Establish clear escalation procedures for when human intervention is required, and ensure support agents have necessary authority to resolve problems.

themes.name: [Negative] Cashback Issues

quotes.text: Taken away accumulated cashback, this is bad
They provide cashback as a trap...one day sudden I'm unable to use cashback... Fraud people are they....
from today I hate this app because I am not able to use 50 rupees cashback for my mobile recharge.
Cashback given by this app is not use in recharge or other bill payment. Now this app is not best to use.
this is fraud app. without my knowledge used my 411 rs cashback in claim to us stock.

Worst update ever! Previously, the cashback could be easily used for bill recharges. Now they have changed the conditions and force us to use the reward balance only for claiming stocks. This is highly unfair to regular users. Giving 1 star!
Cashback fraud Received cashback but it shows as used but i never done transaction for that time. Better to not use this fraud app

themes.description: Users are experiencing issues with their cashback, including being unable to use it on bill payments or having it automatically used for US stocks without their knowledge. This is resulting in a negative user experience and trust issues with the application.
themes.business_impact: High risk of user churn and negative word-of-mouth due to the perception of cashback being confiscated or unusable.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The application's new update has likely changed the way cashback is handled, causing issues with user expectations and trust.
themes.action_plan: • Revert the update to the previous version, conduct user testing to identify the root cause of the issue, and make adjustments to ensure cashback is used as intended. Update the application's documentation and user experience to clearly explain how cashback works.
